events.description: A sudden, violent blast occurs at the platform, shattering the transparent humanoid figure and producing a large cloud of white debris and vapor that rapidly expands outward.

A large, sudden explosive disintegration of an ice sculpture, producing a violent upward and outward spray of ice fragments and vapor, with visible orange flame/combustion at the base during initial rupture.

A violent, rapid expansion of white particulate matter (likely ice or foam) and orange flame erupts from ground level, propagating upward and outward in a classic explosive blast pattern; the plume expands dramatically over time with visible shock-driven fragmentation and debris ejection.

A violent, high-energy explosion originates from two figures in white protective suits on a stage-like structure, producing a massive, rapidly expanding cloud of white particulate debris (likely powder or shattered material) and visible fire/heat at the base; the explosion propagates outward and upward, completely obscuring the subjects within ~1 second and continuing to disperse through frame f15.
